compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Create both the machine-readable JSON sidecar (single source of truth) and the human-readable companion markdown.

## Files to create

### plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.json
Full 27-entry JSON array. Structure:
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "total": 27,
  "groups": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Planning & Requirements", "slugs": [...]},
    ... 9 groups A-I ...
  ],
  "entries": [
    {
      "slug": "<kebab-case>",
      "group": "A",
      "classification_question": "<one sentence>",
      "primary_defense_layer": "<enum value>",
      "defense_artifact_ref": "<prefix:path>",
      "example_tickets": ["<id>", "<id>"],
      "applies_to_project_classes": "all" | "agent_orchestration"
    },
    ...
  ]
}

The 27 slugs must cover the 9 groups (A-I) from the epic spec. Derive from existing DSO bug patterns. Group examples:
- A (Planning): scope-drift, unverified-assumption, missing-acceptance-criteria
- B (LLM-Behavioral): skill-guidance-gap, agent-skips-required-step, llm-output-format-drift
- C (Code Review): unreachable-error-handler, unchecked-exit-code, silent-failure
- D (Integration/CI): test-coverage-gap, mock-production-divergence, integration-test-missing
- E (Concurrency): race-condition, non-atomic-state-update
- F (Failure Paths): missing-rollback, partial-write-no-cleanup, unhandled-edge-case
- G (Defense Manifest): defense-artifact-missing, unchecked-precondition, unacknowledged-degradation
- H (Release/E2E): e2e-not-verified, regression-in-release, config-drift
- I (Operational): runbook-missing, alert-threshold-wrong, oncall-gap

### plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.md
Human-readable companion. Each entry as a markdown table row with description, example tickets, and defense layer. Header includes slug-rename procedure (audit fails if in-use tags reference non-current slug).

## Done when
Running bash tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-registry.sh exits 0 (T1 passes GREEN).
